verdict.rationale: Identity-document coverage is a fair question for an IDV platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack never documents which countries or document types (passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits) are supported, and no supported-document list is published in it. The NFC callbacks for reading 'identity documents' are an adjacent SDK feature and do not show breadth of coverage.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform verifies government IDs from a documented breadth of countries and document types — passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits — with the supported list published
